## Checklist

- [ ] Frontend: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass (if frontend changed)
- [ ] Backend: `python -m pytest` passes (if backend changed)
- [ ] New or changed behavior has tests
- [ ] Database changes ship as an Alembic migration (no schema edits at startup)
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or personal data are included
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` files are updated where relevant
